content.short: Orbital is a licensed payment platform for pay-ins, payouts and FX in stablecoins and 80+ currencies.
content.description: Orbital is a multi-licensed global payments platform that lets businesses collect, convert and pay out in stablecoins, fiat and more than 80 exotic currencies, via web, API or an OTC desk, with over $12 billion in annual flows. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Orbital.
content.meta: Orbital handles stablecoin and fiat pay-ins, payouts and FX in 80+ currencies, listed on Stable.
content.pageTitle: Orbital - Web3 Wallet Tools - Lancers Web3 Explorer
